_comment: Tower unlocks, loaded when the game starts (see DESIGN.md section 11). A new profile owns the `start` towers;
every other tower is unlocked for good by its achievement. The first `discoveries` tier 4 towers ever fused
are unlocked by the fusion itself, so their achievements are never needed. Only the Towers side counts
(but for monsters_pass_won, looted and paused).
Each achievement: name, the tower it unlocks, and goals (one, or two when either one will do). Each goal:
desc (what the player reads), condition, target, plus what the condition needs:
towers_on_map    optional kind: that many towers (of `kind`) on the map at once
in_range         that many monsters inside one tower's range at once
slowed_at_once   that many monsters slowed at once
multi_kill       by: one tower of kind `by` kills that many monsters at once (in the same instant); or, with
kills, it kills at least `kills` at once that many times; scope: level or ever
burst            seconds: that many kills within `seconds`
kills            optional by (tower kinds), by_line (a line from evolution.json: towers of that line, fused
from it included), enemy (monster kinds), how (direct, splash, chain or burn),
slowed (true: only monsters slowed when they died); scope: level (in one level) or ever
leaks            optional enemy (monster kinds); scope: level or ever
boss_kill        boss, seconds: kill that boss within `seconds` of it spawning
wave_cleared     min_monsters: clear a wave in which at least that many monsters spawned (splits included)
level_cleared    optional min_level (1-based), no_leaks (true), only_line (a line from evolution.json:
only towers of that line, fused from it included, dealt damage; others may help);
counts levels cleared that way, over all runs
pass_won         optional finale (true: a pass that ended on a finale), min_gold (gold held at the end);
counts Towers passes won that way, over all runs
monsters_pass_won  counts Monsters passes won, over all runs (a goal the Monsters side counts)
looted           the budget Looters bring back on the Monsters side, added up over all runs
paused           presses of the pause button that paused the game, either side, over all runs
Bosses: secret bosses unlocked the same way (the boss's ambush or pause_trap in monsters.json says where it
shows up), each with name, boss, optional after (a profile milestone: monsters_side, reached by winning a
Towers pass; nothing counts before it), goals, and card: what the card shown on unlocking says (title, deed: what
earned it, lore, hint: of what happens next; the boss isn't named). They're never shown until unlocked.

goals.desc: Have 7 towers on the map at once
Have 3 Frosts on the map at once
A Rifle kills a Tank or an Elite
Kill 30 slowed monsters in one level
Kill the Warden within 20 s of it spawning
Win a Towers pass holding 1,000 gold
Burn towers (Incinerator, Thermal, Dragon) kill 500 monsters
Clear a level from level 5 on without losing a life
Clear a level where only Frost towers deal damage
Snipers or their tier 4 fusions kill 10 Elites
Clear a wave of 60 or more monsters

card.title: SOMETHING STIRS
card.lore: Every one of them was somebody's child. Deep below the path, eight eyes open.
card.hint: Keep killing her young, and she will come to collect.

card.title: A CROWN TURNS
card.deed: You led the horde over the last of the towers
card.lore: The Warden only ever kept the gate. Behind it, something on a throne saw who commands the army now.
card.hint: Break the gatekeeper, and its master may step through.

card.title: YOUR ACCOUNT HAS BEEN FLAGGED
card.lore: Someone upstairs has been reading the ledgers. They like how you do business.
card.hint: Hoard your gold, and someone will come to count it.

card.title: PAUSE NOT RESPONDING
card.lore: Every pause leaves a gap in the code. Something has been living in the gaps.
card.hint: The pause button is broken. Someone calls that a feature.
